answers.core: There is currently no way for something distributed in the asset library to access the EditorInspector's property clipboard.
answers.workaround: No, there is currently no way to access the EditorInspector's property clipboard without compiling a custom build of the editor, preventing editor plugins that wish to do this from being distributed in the asset library.

title: Expose the EditorInspector's property clipboard to GDScript and GDExtension
